lots.name: School Furniture Lot 3

lots.name: School Furniture Lot 4
lots.sustainability_criterion: Furniture must be manufactured using energy-efficient processes and with a low carbon footprint

orchestration_result.final_recommendation: The €900,000 school furniture programme should be divided into four lots, each valued at €220,000, to comply with the EU threshold and ensure competitive bidding. Each lot will include a sustainability criterion and will follow an open procedure. The award criterion for each lot will be based on the best price-quality ratio with 60% weight on price and 40% on quality. The budget share for each lot is 3% of the total annual procurement budget.
